_comment: personal-finance scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a
live config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
PRIVACY: this bench handles your money. A LOCAL model (LM Studio /
llama.cpp / Ollama) keeps everything on your own machine -- strongly
recommended here. The localhost apiBase below assumes a local server; see
docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md. A single chat model is all you need.
Educational, not financial advice. snapshots let you /undo an edit;
pathFence keeps writes inside this workspace.
